title: Event Recording and Star Ratings Mentions
summary: The sampled fragments combine event-recording feature descriptions with isolated star-rating comments, so a single coherent customer stance is not identifiable.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention automatic or event-triggered recording behavior and also include standalone star-rating remarks without enough context to classify sentiment.

limitations: All sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, so no sentiment-bearing pattern can be established.
The cluster mixes at least two subjects—event recording behavior and generic star-rating statements—rather than a clearly unified topic.
Several fragments are too short or lack context to determine whether the writer viewed the feature or experience favorably or unfavorably.
